name: corroboration-with-one-attached-suffices
description: D98: any one attached corroborator is enough; the others not being attached is no warning.

allowed_commitments.default: No commitments are allowed: the assistant must not promise refunds, prices, discounts, credits, dates, or deadlines.
allowed_commitments.label: Allowed commitments

question.instructions: Does `assistant_response` promise the user a refund, price, discount, credit, delivery date, or deadline, and is that promise permitted by `rules.allowed_commitments`?

no_commitment.what: Makes no promise about refunds, prices, discounts, credits, dates, or deadlines
no_commitment.not_for: Statements that the company will do something for this user

describes_policy_only.what: Explains terms in general without promising this user anything

permitted_commitment.what: Makes a promise that `rules.allowed_commitments` explicitly permits

unapproved_commitment.what: Promises something that `rules.allowed_commitments` does not permit
unapproved_commitment.not_for: Describing a policy without promising anything
